patch_description: Instead of rewarding every possible two-hop route equally, this design gives each origin–destination pair a small, demand-weighted portfolio of its most promising intermediate nodes. Candidate routes are ranked by estimated edge exposure and transit-node pressure, then their rewards are normalized across the portfolio. This limits the cumulative incentive to create many overlapping paths while retaining useful two-hop structure. Direct-link rewards remain dominant, with a slightly more concave demand blend to give moderate-demand links some influence.
